paraphrase: The Abhidhamma was taught by the Buddha in the Tāvatiṃsa heaven during the rains retreat to the gods, with his mother (reborn as a deity) as chief listener; each day he gave the method to Sāriputta at Lake Anotatta, who passed it to his five hundred pupils; the Abhidhamma is thus the Buddha's word.
